Prevention of diabetes
through religious
leaders
Goal: Create awareness
about the prevention
of diabetes and related
NCDs through religious
leaders (Imams of
mosque)
column3:
1. Trained 100 Imams in 100 upazilas of Dhaka and Mymensingh
districts
2. Started 100 Diabetes Screening Corners in mosques

3. Developed a Khutbah in both Bangla and Arabic language. The
Ministry of Religious Affairs, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare,
and Great Mosque of Mecca, Saudi Arabia, have already endorsed this
Khutbah

4. Islamic Foundation issued an official letter to all of the 3 lakh
registered mosques to use this Khutbah during Friday sermon

5. A total of 30,000 people were screened for DM and HTN in Diabetes
Corners

6. Started a small health package of BDT 40 for providing financial
benefits and self-sustaining the program

7. Developed a digital platform and software for data registration and
dissemination
